core_obligations: Choice freedom: the auxiliary (i_1, W) in the good diagram is immaterial for the statement (finite-type-gives-well-defined-system remark).

Construction of W: proper-limit-of-proper-fp gives a closed immersion X -> X' with X' -> S proper of finite presentation; descend-finite-presentation and eventually-proper give i_3 and a proper W -> Y_{i_3} with X' = Y x_{Y_{i_3}} W.
Conclusion: for i >= i_3, X_i is a closed subscheme of Y_i x_{Y_{i_3}} W, hence proper over Y_i (closed subschemes of proper morphisms are proper).
proof_roadmap: Fix the freedom of the auxiliary choice.
Build the proper envelope and its finite-level model.
X_i as a closed subscheme; conclude properness.
difficulty_reason: Immateriality of the auxiliary choice (cited remark) + explicit construction of W: closed immersion into a proper fp X' (engine), descend-fp + eventually-proper give the proper finite-level model, and X_i is then a closed subscheme of a scheme proper over Y_i. Multi-engine construction.
